name: Product Design & Development
summary: A structured path from customer need to validated product: specifications, concept generation and selection, embodiment, prototyping and testing.

topics.name: Product development processes: stage-gate, spiral and agile hardware
Product specifications and quality function deployment (QFD)
Concept generation: brainstorming, morphological charts, biomimicry, TRIZ
Concept selection: Pugh matrix and weighted decision matrices
Industrial design, aesthetics and user experience
Human factors and ergonomics in design (anthropometry, usability)
Prototyping strategy: looks-like vs works-like models and rapid prototyping
Systems engineering basics: requirements, interfaces, V-model and trade studies
Intellectual property: patents and freedom to operate
Sustainable design and design for environment
Project management, design reviews and the capstone design project
